extension.description: Free K9s terminal for local and remote Kubernetes contexts in VS Code.
command.open: Jaewon K9s: Open K9s for a Kubernetes Context
settings.title: Jaewon K9s
settings.kubectlPath: Path to the kubectl executable used to list contexts.
settings.kubeconfig: Optional kubeconfig file path. Empty uses KUBECONFIG and the default user config.
settings.commandTimeout: Timeout for kubectl context discovery and K9s version checks in milliseconds.
